description: Hybrid L0 overview. Keeps aggregate answer-first triage for the selected workflow/pipeline/run_type scope, adds explicit scope/provenance/first-action header semantics, and exposes a control-plane-backed run_id selector without reintroducing run_id into Prometheus labels.

options.content: 0. Control Plane1. Overview2. Runtime3. Provider Health4. Data Quality5. WorkflowSilver Reject ExplorerExplore LogsExplore Traces

panels.title: Navigation
panels.description: Top navigation bus for the dashboard suite. Uses same-tab handoffs, preserves the current time range for dashboard-to-dashboard links, resets unsupported dashboard-specific scope where needed, and exposes Explore Logs plus an Explore Traces adjunct. Explore Traces is available only for traced runs and requires the optional tracing profile. This hybrid surface remains aggregate-first and does not leak future execution selectors into the navigation model.

links.title: 3. Provider Health
links.tooltip: Context mapping: provider=unknown, pipeline_context=$pipeline, adapter=unknown. Visible workflow/pipeline/run_type are preserved; provider remains fail-closed when unknown.

links.title: 4. Data Quality
links.tooltip: Open the Data Quality dashboard in the same tab.

links.title: 5. Workflow
links.tooltip: Scoped handoff: passes workflow/pipeline/run_type context; Workflow owns its evidence-only status filters.

links.title: Silver Reject Explorer
links.tooltip: Cross-scope handoff: bounded pipeline/run_type explorer scope. Reset scope: Silver Reject Explorer owns its own record-level filters. Opens in the same tab.

links.title: Explore Logs
links.tooltip: Requires optional tracing profile. Opens Logs Drilldown in the same tab with safe {job="bioetl"} baseline. Zero lines can legitimately mean Loki shipping is disabled, no BioETL log streams were shipped in range, or the baseline query still needs refinement inside Explore.

links.title: Explore Traces
links.tooltip: Available only for traced runs. Enable tracing with --tracing or BIOETL_OBSERVABILITY__TRACING_ENABLED=true. Opens Traces Drilldown in the same tab with bounded pipeline/run_type TraceQL scope. NoOpTracing or tracing-off runs can legitimately be empty, so treat this as adjunct evidence rather than first-screen proof.

options.content: What is broken or degraded right now, and where should the operator drill down first?

panels.description: L0 v3 scope/provenance banner. Primary question: what is broken now and where should the operator drill down first? Scope: workflow=$workflow, pipeline=$pipeline, run_type=$run_type, run_id=$run_id, selected Grafana time range. Provenance: shipped Prometheus current-status recording rules plus selected-range evidence. Known limitation: first-screen PromQL remains pipeline/run_type-scoped; workflow is context/evidence-first, and run_id is resolved from persisted control-plane manifests for dashboard handoff rather than exact PromQL intersection.

panels.title: Status
panels.description: Current L0 operator state for Overview. Status values are OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null). CRIT means runtime, DQ, control-plane, workflow, or gold signals are failing for the selected pipeline/run_type. WARN means non-fatal DQ, provider, or pending-gold conditions. UNKNOWN means the dashboard cannot prove current health for the selected scope.

panels.description: Action route projection for the selected pipeline/run_type. The row exposes `action_target`, `action_reason`, and `action_dashboard_uid`; Runtime > Control Plane > Gold Lifecycle > DQ > Provider > Workflow > Monitor. Use the panel link whose title matches the routed target. Provider route fail-closes to `provider=unknown` while preserving `pipeline_context`; workflow handoff resets scope because the workflow dashboard does not accept pipeline/run_type variables.

panels.description: Compact selected workflow/pipeline scope for the first-screen overview, excluding the synthetic `test_pipe` surface. Each row keeps the worst current workflow status per matching pipeline so the first screen stays readable without unrelated pipeline leakage. Status values are OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null). Current workflow status is driven by the latest bounded terminal workflow signal, not by cumulative workflow-run counters. `run_type` and `run_id` remain handoff context only for this card.

panels.title: Runtime Blockers Trend
panels.description: Selected-range L1 runtime evidence for the active pipeline/run_type scope. This compact trend is below the current verdict path and does not determine L0 Status or First Action. Shows OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null); missing series or gaps remain diagnostic and must not be treated as OK. Open Runtime for detailed blocker conditions.

panels.title: DQ Status Trend
panels.description: Selected-range L1 Data Quality evidence for the active pipeline/run_type scope. This compact trend is below the current verdict path and does not determine L0 Status or First Action. Renders discrete OK/WARN/CRIT/UNKNOWN states; numeric values are hidden from the operator view. missing series or gaps remain diagnostic and must not be treated as OK. Open Data Quality for detailed DQ conditions.

panels.title: Gold Lifecycle Trend
panels.description: Selected-range L1 data-validation lifecycle evidence for the active pipeline/run_type scope. This compact trend is below the current verdict path and does not determine L0 Status or First Action. Legend includes pipeline/run_type/lifecycle_state; disabled Gold stage returns OK as a valid non-error state. Missing series or gaps remain diagnostic and must not be treated as OK. Open Runtime for lifecycle-state detail or Control Plane for replay/manifest context.

panels.title: Historical Failures
panels.description: Selected-range historical failure evidence only. Keeps pipeline and run_type labels from the active Grafana window and remains below the current verdict path; it does not determine L0 Status or First Action. Zero matching rows means no failed-run samples in the selected range, not proof that the current scope is OK. Open Runtime for failed-run and blocker localization.

panels.title: Recent Terminal Runs
panels.description: Selected-range terminal-run evidence only. Shows non-success terminal statuses grouped by pipeline so the evidence table stays readable without scroll while preserving the active Grafana time window. This panel is below the current verdict path and does not determine L0 Status or First Action; no terminal rows is not proof that the current scope is OK. Open Control Plane for manifest/terminal-run proof or Runtime for execution localization.

panels.title: Silver Rejects + Rate
panels.description: Selected-range Silver filter reject count and ratio against Bronze records. Evidence only; current DQ incident state lives in Data Quality.
Operator note for raw metric starting points and cross-dashboard diagnostics handoffs; no datasource query is expected.

options.content:
Raw metric starting points for this dashboard are
System Status: bioetl_l0_status{pipeline=~"chembl_assay",run_type=~"incremental"},
First Action route: bioetl_l0_next_action_route{pipeline=~"chembl_assay",run_type=~"incremental"},
Input Status: bioetl_l0_input_status_selected{pipeline=~"chembl_assay",run_type=~"incremental"}.
Exact blocker reasons live in the Control Plane, Runtime, Data Quality, Provider Health, and Workflow dashboards.
Historical evidence stays in the row above.

panels.title: ID
panels.description: Compact two-column local control-plane identity table. Shows Run ID, Manifest ID, Provider.Entity [Version], Contract [Schema], Execution, execution flags, Replay [Capability.Mode], Checkpoint [Anchors], optional Composite Run, and Identity Health. Exact selected run_id wins; aggregate pipeline scope without exact run_id must not guess one manifest identity; values come from HTTP, not Prometheus labels. No data/datasource errors on this HTTP-backed card mean the Quarantine Explorer/control-plane backend may be unavailable; verify /health/live before interpreting the card as expected empty.

defaults.noValue: No identity rows. Check Quarantine Explorer/control-plane backend health (/health/live) and selected pipeline/run_id before treating this as no selected run.

panels.title: Processed Records
panels.description: Current stage/outcome accounting evidence for the selected pipeline/run_type scope. Uses bounded stage/outcome accounting recording rules; missing accounting series render UNKNOWN/no data, not OK. Summary status, accounted subtotal, and delta rows are intentionally not displayed in this compact table; use Status and detailed recording rules for verdict/delta triage. No data/datasource errors on this HTTP-backed card mean the Quarantine Explorer/control-plane backend may be unavailable; verify /health/live before interpreting the card as expected empty.

defaults.noValue: No processed-record rows. Check Quarantine Explorer backend health and selector scope; backend unavailable is not a valid zero-record state.

panels.title: Triage Alert State
panels.description: Actual Prometheus alert-state triage for firing and pending BioETL rules. This panel reads the Prometheus `ALERTS` series and does not duplicate alert business logic in dashboard queries; inactive/no-alert state is rendered as an explicit zero row.
